integrity: Proof uses a positive transport-coupling dual identity, exact covariance evaluation and all-equality classification; finite exact-rational checks corroborate the proof. No independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Intrinsic Frobenius inball of normalized nonnegative nonsymmetric rectangular Monge polytopes, not John ellipsoids, other metrics or weighted cones; square subfamily already known; potential older equivalent rectangular formulation remains possible.
title: A greatest-common-divisor law for Euclidean inballs and center cubes of rectangular Monge polytopes
